questions.question: Who played Katniss Everdeen in The Hunger Games films?
questions.note: The 2012 original, then three sequels. Woodley starred in the rival YA series Divergent.

questions.question: Who directed Gravity (2013), the space-survival film starring Sandra Bullock?
questions.note: He won Best Director. George Clooney co-stars. Cuarón also made Y Tu Mamá También and Roma.

questions.question: Who played Amy Dunne in Gone Girl (2014)?
questions.note: Affleck is her husband, Nick. David Fincher directed; Gillian Flynn wrote the novel and the script.

questions.question: Who played the title mercenary in Deadpool (2016)?
questions.note: Wade Wilson is the character’s name. Jackman is Wolverine, who later shares a film with him.

questions.question: Who played Peter Quill, a.k.a. Star-Lord, in Guardians of the Galaxy?
questions.note: 2014, directed by James Gunn. Evans is Captain America; Hemsworth is Thor; Pine is Star Trek’s Kirk.

questions.question: Who played Rey in the Star Wars sequel trilogy?
questions.note: The Force Awakens (2015) introduced her. Jones is Jyn Erso in Rogue One.

questions.question: Who played Freddie Mercury in Bohemian Rhapsody (2018)?
questions.note: He won Best Actor. Baron Cohen was once attached to the role. Egerton played Elton John in Rocketman.

questions.question: Who voiced Miles Morales in Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018)?
questions.note: Johnson voices Peter B. Parker; Cage voices Spider-Man Noir. Glover voices Aaron Davis, the Prowler.

questions.question: Who directed Arrival (2016), the first-contact film starring Amy Adams?
questions.note: From Ted Chiang’s Story of Your Life. Villeneuve later made Blade Runner 2049 and Dune.

questions.question: Who directed and co-starred in the 2018 remake of A Star Is Born?
questions.note: Gaga plays Ally. Eastwood was once attached to direct an earlier version of this remake.
